ai_judgment.response: Yes. This is an agent issue because it involves a misconfiguration of token-related parameters (`max_tokens` and `thinking.budget_tokens`) when using the Claude model from Anthropic, which falls under the category of "Token usage misconfiguration" in LLM operation issues.
